title: Locating Demographic Bias at the Attention-Head Level in CLIP’s Vision Encoder

bias_targets.methodology: Locating bias in vision transformer attention heads using projected residual-stream decomposition and zero-shot Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) with gender-related text prototypes. The effect of specific attention heads on gender disparities is then quantified via mean ablation and measuring changes in Cramér's V on profession classification using the FACET benchmark.

Identifying age-biased attention heads by measuring alignment with age-related text prototypes (Young, Middle, Older) using zero-shot CAVs. The impact of these heads is evaluated through mean ablation and analyzing shifts in prediction distributions and Cramér's V across age groups.
